origin.reason: English rendering of the router-core design template, with status notes where a step is not implemented yet. A request is routed to READ, PLAN, RUN, AUDIT, SYNC, PROJECT, UPDATE, WORK or LEADER through references/routes.json; an open question is sorted before anyone is asked; a report figure names its command (an empty output is not zero); and the skill asks the host's agent tool for delegation.

Written for the Aside adapter: when MoAI uses Aside, the commands that print Aside's version-matched guides (aside guide, aside skills), the permission lines (Guard by default, full-access only with the user's confirmation), CLI only and never MCP, and the fallback when Aside is missing. Checked against https://docs.aside.com/help/developers and /help/security and the Aside CLI 1.26.1111.1046 help (read 2026-11-13). No design-22 template exists for adapters.

Written for the Orca adapter: when MoAI uses Orca, the commands that print Orca's version-matched guides (orca skills get orca-cli, orca agent-context --json), the lines MoAI keeps and the fallback when Orca is missing. Written for SPEC-20261122-next-flow-skills-agents (REQ-6, REQ-7, text slice B; decisions D-4, D-5, D-6): the one audit contract, at most 6144 bytes. What the auditor receives, what it returns, which session records the verdict (a card note read by the lander) and that the author of a change never audits it, with five side rules: a local code review of the base..head range without its fix or comment options, a re-audit to the first auditor, a lane's tree-bound check receipt, no forked or advisor session, and a finding without file and line counts as none. It absorbs the former internal review note, whose two security sentences keep their pins (tests/core_rules_2876.rs), and points to RUN's check-run rules instead of restating them. Named by the AUDIT row of chains/index.md and by the moai-audit agent's body.
